{{Quote|I have. Though not since that kid back on Tatooine. You're all too young to remember&mdash;but I'll never forget. That was something.|Unidentified Rodian|<ref name="Target" />}}
This '''unidentified individual''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].<ref name="Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Rodian was a spectator of the [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] [[Muunilinst Podrace|held]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. When the others were surprised that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]], was leading the race, the Rodian recalled that he's seen another [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Human]] perform a similar feat back on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Target" />
